text:
aisha: AP-SOUTH1 reporting sudden GPU node churn, backlog x6 on generation queues. seeing preempt and NIC-reset events. large-llm workers throwing OOMs, autoscaler not keeping up. tagging ops.
raj: Any dedicated customers impacted or just hosted?
aisha: A mix — a few dedicated pools lost 1-2 GPUs but most hit is hosted capacity for large models. Spot churn + one noisy host network blip.
leah: I can push emergency shaping rules to the rate-limiter and change routing to prefer smaller variants for non-SLA tenants. recommend: 60% token rate for free/standard tiers and immediate model fallback mapping (redwood-xl -> redwood-large) for requests > 2048 tokens.
marco: Support/CS heads — we need a short customer-facing blurb for the top 10 paying customers that might see throughput drops. also include instructions if they want to failover workloads.
tilly: Drafting message now, will ping legal for wording on SLAs.
leah: Pushing config now. patch: ```bash
curl -X POST https://rate-limiter.internal/api/v1/rules -H 'Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN' -d '{"rule_name":"ap-south1-emergency-shape","conditions":{"region":"ap-south1","customer_tier":["free","standard"]},"limits":{"tokens_per_min":"0.6*baseline"},"priority":100}'
```
leah: rollback: ```bash
curl -X DELETE https://rate-limiter.internal/api/v1/rules/ap-south1-emergency-shape -H 'Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN'
```
deploy-bot: Router-config v2.14 deployed by leah at 1998743360 — changed routing policy and added fallback table.
sre-bot: Alert: queue_length(ap-south1/gpu-gen)=4350 (+520%), tail_latency P99=1.8s (+30%) — monitoring.
raj: Also add a per-customer soft-quota table so we can cap large tenants if needed. propose per-tenant weight caps: top-20 tenants get 1.2x baseline, next-80 get 0.8x, rest default 0.5x. We can tune by revenue tag.
aisha: Good. Implement partial rollout: enable shaping for free/standard first, monitor 10m, then apply soft-quotas if backlog not reducing. If still >3000 after 30m we will start targeted throttling of the top offending sessions (per-session token rate limit).
marco: I'll compile a list of the top offending customer IDs from logs and attach to the thread.
tilly: Customer note ready. short: "We’re experiencing degraded GPU capacity in AP-SOUTH1 causing slower responses for some large-model requests. We’ve applied temporary rate-limits and model fallbacks to maintain availability. If you need guaranteed capacity, contact your account team for dedicated capacity options"
aisha: Thanks. Monitoring dashboards: https://grafana.internal/d/south1/gpu-ops — watch backlog and cluster_free_gpus. tagging @channel for visibility.
leah: Confirmed rule active, fallback table in place. observed QPS drop 22% and backlog down 18% in first 8m. continuing to monitor.
raj: If backlog trending back up, next step is cross-region spill to AP-SOUTHEAST1 with degraded QoS — need approval from infra lead.
aisha: Agreed. Escalate if >20% customers impacted or >1h.
marco: Noted. I'll update the incident doc and notify sales for top accounts.
tilly: Support has sent messages to the 12 customers on the list. will update when replies arrive.
sre-bot: Action item created: INCIDENT-AP-SOUTH1-SHAPE-1998743210 assigned to aisha, leah, raj. due in 2h.
aisha: Thanks team. keep thread clean: short status updates only.
